name: InToolz
description: InToolz is a management tool for Microsoft Intune designed to simplify cross-tenant migrations and bulk configuration tasks. It enables tenant-to-tenant copy of Intune content, bulk assignment deployment and removal between groups, profiles, and applications, and mass updates to description fields. Note that the project is a work in progress, with several features planned for future releases.
keywords: how to copy intune apps between tenants
transfer intune profiles to new tenant
author: Jørgen Sundet

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase shows legitimate administrative tooling patterns (Intune/Graph usage) with no obfuscated code, no remote code execution, no credential harvesting, and no hardcoded secrets. Primary security considerations are: (1) the breadth of Microsoft Graph permissions requested (potential over-privilege); (2) the ability to swap authentication contexts across tenants (tenant isolation risk); and (3) logging practices that could inadvertently expose sensitive data. Recommend tightening scopes to the minimum required, reinforcing tenant isolation and auditing for tenant-switch operations, and implementing secure, privacy-conscious logging. No immediate indicators of malicious activity were found.
